associations.rationale: The type states only the dimension-two component; it does not itself state that the subspace is invariant and irreducible, so it does not state the complete claimed representation model.
The type states only invariance under the right-regular action; it does not itself state the dimension-two and irreducibility components of the complete claimed representation model.
The type states only the irreducibility component for invariant submodules; it does not itself state the dimension-two and right-regular-subrepresentation components of the complete claimed model.
